observations: Small blue LPG gas cylinder wrapped in a black wire mesh/cage cover.
A single-burner gas stove head (burner) sits on top of the cylinder, attached by a thin gas line.
A separate metal stand/frame (the 'sitter') cradles the burner above the cylinder neck.
Brass/copper burner nozzle shows dark tarnish and soot staining, suggesting prior use.
Text 'AMAZE' is embossed on the black burner stand in photo 2.
No capacity marking (e.g. 3kg/6kg/12.5kg) or manufacture date stamp is visible on the cylinder collar in any photo.
A valve knob and a pressure-gauge-like dial are visible on the cylinder neck in photo 1.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI / DANIEL USHIE' overlays all three photos.

identity.kind: gas cylinder with single burner and stand (sitter)

claims.claim: Almost brand new, used for less than 2 months
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 2 show a tarnished, soot-stained brass burner nozzle, not consistent with near-new/2-month use.
Photo 0 and 2 show the burner head and metal stand (sitter) physically attached/sitting on the cylinder.

risks.risk: Cylinder capacity (kg size) unknown, which drives most of the price
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the stamped capacity marking on the cylinder collar/neck
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since size range is too wide to assume a worst case

risks.risk: Cylinder age/manufacture and re-test (DOT/SON) date unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped date code on the collar
risks.if_unproven: priced as an older/unverified-safety cylinder, lower end

risks.risk: Valve or gauge may leak or be faulty
risks.proof: Short video showing valve being turned and a leak/soap-bubble test, or gas lighting the burner

risks.risk: Actual gas content level inside cylinder (full, partial, empty) unverifiable
risks.proof: Weighing scale photo showing gross weight, or seller statement with tare weight comparison

risks.risk: Burner/sitter functional state (ignition, flame consistency) unverified
risks.proof: Video of burner lit with a steady blue flame

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the capacity (kg) stamp on the cylinder collar
Close-up photo of the manufacture/re-test date stamp
Video of valve operation and a soap-bubble leak test
Video of the burner lit and running on gas
response.reason: The cylinder's capacity, which is the main price driver for LPG cylinders, cannot be read from any photo, and the 'almost new' claim is contradicted by visible wear on the burner, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a capacity shot.
